summary: RptMnuReport_Wizards is a partial class within the HSPnet.UserControls.ReportMenu namespace, responsible for handling report wizards in a web application. It includes a GridView for displaying data and an ObjectDataSource for data operations.
purpose: The class is designed to facilitate the display and management of report wizards through a web interface, handling operations and events related to user sessions and wizard selection.

fields.name: gridData
fields.description: A GridView control for displaying wizard data, automatically generated and requires modifications in the code-behind file.

fields.name: dsWizards
fields.description: An ObjectDataSource control to manage data operations for the wizard, automatically generated and requires modifications in the code-behind file.

workflows.name: Data Selection
steps: If null, cancel the data selection operation.
If not null, set input parameters for session and user status (PlacingUser and ReceivingUser).

workflows.name: Row Command Execution
steps: On command 'cmdWizards', cache the current user session.
Redirect to ReportWizardMenu.aspx with appended session query string and WizardID.

business_rules: Data operations are cancelled if UserSession is not active.
system_behavior: Handles the selection and row command events for report wizards.
Manages user session data caching and page redirections based on command inputs.
dependencies: QueryString utility class for URL manipulations.
exceptions: Cancellation of data operations if UserSession is invalid or null.
